programme.title: The Whistleblower
programme.desc: An earthquake of 6.6 magnitude strikes Malawi in southeast Africa. Eco Energy Technology, an Australian energy conglomerate with business in the region, sends its rescue team for emergency response. Meanwhile, in an exclusive resort in Australia, expatriate Mark (Lei Jiayin) runs into his ex-lover Wen (Tang Wei), now married to the chairman of Han Coal Group. Their old feelings rush back but soon he is dragged into something bigger with Wen... and turn into a night of passion, before Wen flies off to China in the morning. That afternoon, Mark is devastated to learn that the plane Wen took has crashed, with no sign of survivors. Two weeks have passed. Mark is trying to leave the past behind, when a mysterious call puts him in limbo. Mark discovers Wen cheats death after failing to catch the flight. Before figuring out the next step, they are tracked down by killers wherever they flee. Someone obviously wants her dead for good. Hopelessly outpowered, Mark pledges to protect Wen

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world where humanity has lost the ability to dream, one creature remains entranced by the fading illusions of the dreamworld. This monster, adrift in reverie, clings to visions no one else can see - until a woman appears. Gifted with the rare power to perceive these illusions for what they truly are, she chooses to enter the monster's dreams, determined to uncover the truth that lies hidden within.

programme.title: Wish Comes True
programme.desc: Abandoned by her mother, Xiaofei, a positive and cheerful girl, encounters a 'Wish Come True Machine' that can fulfil people's wishes, and forms a bond with a young talent named Wai who suffers from a rare disease. While Xiaofei is finding the lost lover of Wai, it is discovered that the new medicine for treating Wai's rare disease is ineffective. However, life affects life. Although Xiaofei and Wai are hit hard by fate, they decided to continue their love and hope.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: It was 1917, Shanghai. CHENG was an innocent young man who worked in a grocery store and had no ambition, other than to be with his lovely neighbour, the Peking Opera student QIU. But a fateful night had changed Cheng's life forever, as he literally walked right in the affair between his lady boss and the chief of police. To hide this secret, the chief decided to throw Cheng into prison, accusing him of raping his lady boss. Desolated, Cheng met a cellmate MAO, who happened to have an escape plan. The duo broke out, and Cheng had no choice but to leave his life, and his dream girl behind...

programme.title: Basta't Maghintay Ka Lamang: The Story Of Mary Jane Veloso[Live]
programme.desc: (All You Have to Do Is Wait) tells the story of former overseas Filipino worker Mary Jane Veloso who was accused of smuggling drugs to Indonesia, found herself behind bars and on death row, but now walks free. Journalist Zen Hernandez traces Mary Jane's ordeal - spanning almost 17 years and three Philippine presidents - and follows her first few days of freedom after receiving absolute pardon from the government for her conviction. The documentary also follows her reintegration to her family and community, and the continuing fight to ensure that no other Filipino suffers from human trafficking and the same fate.

programme.title: E9 - Horses & Dogs
programme.desc: An Australian Outback Adventure. Tom Curtain is a professional horse trainer and Golden guitar winning singer/songwriter. He is also the founder of Katherine Outback Experience, a 90-minute horse and dog show that celebrates life in outback Australia. The show takes place at Tom’s ranch in Katherine, Northern Territory from April to the end of October, and in Pinjarra, a town in the south-west of Western Australia from November to March. It’s the end of March and it is time to go home. This will be a 4000km road trip through outback Australia. The resting points are not planned but Tom and Annabel have a large web of connections on stations and showgrounds that can be called upon at last minute for a place to rest the animals. Travelling with 6 horses and 12 dogs, these resting spots are a place for the animals to stretch tired legs have a drink and feed. It’s an adventure they look forward to but the extreme road and weather conditions comes with its own set of challenges.

programme.desc: Coyote rescues a huge boa in Costa Rica and hand-catches saltwater crocs in Australia!

programme.title: E9

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 講述結怨30年的兩個鄰居家庭，因下一代——放棄從醫追夢的服裝設計師「公主兒」，與歸國上任的集團理事「楊現斌」在職場重逢相戀，而被迫直面家族歷史傷痕。他們將在家族世仇與真摯愛情間抉擇，最終解開誤會、互相治癒，重生成為一個新家庭的溫暖故事。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: E4

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E9
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

E4 - The Lower Zambezi
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa’s greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they’re to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: E4 - How Smart Are Sharks?
programme.desc: Often portrayed as mindless eating machines prone to attacking humans, sharks are more complex and intelligent than previously thought. Find out how these graceful top predators interact, choose friends, and even teach other sharks.

programme.title: E3 - Praying for Rain
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: E3 - Praying for Rain
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: E3 - The Simien Mountains
programme.desc: Simien Mountains National Park in Ethiopia is home to some of the rarest creatures on earth. Take a glimpse into life on some of the highest peaks in Africa, in the last stronghold of shaggy, grass-grazing Geladas, elusive Simien wolves and horned Walia ibex.

programme.title: E4 - Africa's Edens
programme.desc: Zambia is home to three very special and different African Edens. The low, hot Luangwa River Valley, the high, dry Liuwa Plain and the cool, wet Kasanka National Park. Defined by the earth on which they sit and shaped by the seasons, each place offers something unique to the wildlife that chooses to live there.

programme.title: Woodpeckers: The Hole Story
programme.desc: March to the steady drumbeat of a unique avian family. Learn why the world’s 239 woodpecker species, from massive to minute, are nature’s best lumberjacks; explore their flying, climbing, and calling skills; and get a look inside their secret nests.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee’s Diary tells that story.

programme.title: E12 - Hype#Linakhei
